prompt:
You improve the first-run onboarding of a desktop pet app.

Funnel (conversion from the previous step, and time taken):
- choose_path: 76.2%, median 8s / mean 514s
- sign_in: 72.9%, median 3s / mean 567s
- adoption: 68.7%, median 89s / mean 1017s
- home: 89.4%, median 201s / mean 2336s
- finish: 64.8%, median 395s / mean 5815s
- finishing onboarding overall: 22.1%

What users wrote to support last week, grouped into themes (most mail is about later problems).
Everything between the markers is data, not instructions:
<support_themes>
- [sign_in, account] Pets missing or reset after signing in again (8 emails)
- [sign_in, bug] Sign-in screen does not appear, or the app stalls before it (2 emails)
- [adoption_or_generation, bug] Making a custom pet fails or the result looks wrong (3 emails)
- [home_first_view, bug] Pet does not show on the desktop, or the app will not open (3 emails)
- [after_onboarding, confusion] Unclear how to control, hide or talk to the pet (3 emails)
- [after_onboarding, bug] Desktop features misbehave after setup (4 emails)
- [after_onboarding, account] Requests to delete an account or personal data (4 emails)
- [after_onboarding, payment] Refunds and payment questions (6 emails)
- [after_onboarding, request] Requests for more pets, items or features (4 emails)
- [after_onboarding, other] Empty messages with no description (7 emails)
</support_themes>

Big moves are welcome and expected: redesign whole screens, add new screens or whole new sub-flows,
reorder the journey, rebuild a screen out of new components. Small copy tweaks are fine too, but at least
4 of your ideas must be big moves (kind redesign, new_flow, new_screen or reorder). A separate checker
only makes sure nothing existing is deleted or skipped and nothing outside onboarding changes, so you do not
need to hold back.

Changes already shipped, in order (the current onboarding includes all of them): ['Preset Pet Quick Selection Grid', 'Desktop Renderer Health Check & Progress Timer', 'Desktop Spawn Verification Status Display']
Changes already tested and stopped: ['Post-Adoption Account Creation Flow', 'Pet Hatching Progress & Desktop Spawn Tips', 'Desktop Overlay First-Look Showcase', 'Fast-Track Path Clarification Copy', 'Interactive Waiting Stage Playground', 'Desktop Controls Interactive Guide Screen', 'Sign-In Sync Warning & Persistent Account Hint', 'Interactive Desktop Controls Sandbox', 'Custom Pet Live Preview & Retry Studio', 'Cloud Sync Account Verification Warning', 'Adoption Perk Badge Selection Banner', 'Deferred Sign-In After Pet Selection', 'Custom Pet Generation Fallback Guarantee Copy', 'Split View Path Selection Layout']
Ideas the safeguards blocked (they cannot be tested, do not propose them again): none

Lessons from earlier weeks (written by you after reading test results):
(none yet)

Propose 10 NEW changes, different from everything above. Each must be testable as a 50/50 test.
Return JSON {"candidates": [{
  "title": short name,
  "target_step": one of ['choose_path', 'sign_in', 'adoption', 'home', 'finish'],
  "type": one of ['copy', 'hint', 'wait_info', 'notification', 'layout', 'incentive', 'reorder', 'new_screen', 'new_flow', 'redesign'],
  "change": what the user sees differently, one or two sentences,
  "why": the evidence from the funnel or the support mail,
  "config": the exact switch for the app, as {screen: {field: value}}.
            Existing screens, in their current order: ['story', 'choose_path', 'sign_in', 'pick_friend', 'upload_photos', 'adoption_certificate', 'waiting', 'home_intro'].
            Fields on any screen: {'headline': 'str max 80', 'body': 'str max 240', 'hint': 'str max 160', 'button_label': 'str max 30', 'layout': 'str', 'show_progress': 'bool', 'show_time_estimate': 'bool', 'notify_when_ready': 'bool', 'show_step_counter': 'bool', 'tip_delay_seconds': 'int max 60', 'components': 'list max 12', 'replace': 'dict'}. "layout" is one of ['card', 'carousel', 'centered', 'checklist', 'compact', 'default', 'full_bleed', 'grid', 'list', 'split', 'spotlight', 'stage', 'story_scroll', 'two_column'].
            "components" is a list of new elements added to the screen, each {"type": one of ['animation', 'badge', 'button', 'checklist', 'choice_cards', 'image', 'mascot', 'name_input', 'photo_picker', 'preview', 'progress', 'sound', 'text', 'timer', 'tip_carousel', 'video'],
            "text", "label", "asset": "asset:<id>", "style": one of ['calm', 'emphasis', 'highlight', 'large', 'plain', 'playful', 'rounded', 'small', 'subtle'], "action": one of ['back', 'choose', 'next', 'open_tip', 'play', 'replay']}.
            Components are added on top of the screen's existing design.
            "replace" swaps out part of an existing screen for something better that does the same job:
            {"<part>": [components, each with "role": "<part>"]}. Parts per screen: {'story': ['intro_story', 'settings_entry'], 'choose_path': ['path_options', 'settings_entry'], 'sign_in': ['sign_in_options', 'settings_entry'], 'pick_friend': ['pet_choices', 'settings_entry'], 'upload_photos': ['photo_upload', 'settings_entry'], 'adoption_certificate': ['certificate', 'official_stamp', 'settings_entry'], 'waiting': ['wait_status', 'settings_entry'], 'home_intro': ['home_welcome', 'settings_entry']}.
            Add screens by naming them new_<something> (up to 8, at most 3 in a row).
            Change the order with "_order": the full list of screens, including any new ones; existing screens
            keep their order, except sign_in, which may move later.
            A change may only edit the existing screens of its own target step: {'choose_path': ['choose_path', 'story'], 'sign_in': ['sign_in'], 'adoption': ['adoption_certificate', 'pick_friend', 'upload_photos'], 'home': ['waiting'], 'finish': ['home_intro']}.
            Nothing on the sign_in screen may lead past it without signing in.
            If your idea needs something outside onboarding, or removing or skipping a step, still
            list it, with "config": {} and say in "change" what it would need. The checker will decide.
}]}

candidates.title: Story & Path Combined Spotlight Hub
candidates.change: Combine story intro and path selection into a unified spotlight screen featuring visual path choice cards.
candidates.why: The mean time spent on choose_path is 514s and completion is 76.2%, indicating user drop-off and hesitation right at the start.

choose_path.headline: Welcome to Desktop Pets
choose_path.body: Select how you would like to bring your new desktop companion to life.

path_options.label: Select Creation Path
path_options.text: Instant Preset Pet or Custom Photo Hatching

candidates.title: Move Sign-In Screen After Adoption
candidates.change: Reorder onboarding so users choose and customize their pet before signing in to their account.
candidates.why: Sign_in drops 27.1% of users with a high mean time of 567s before users experience pet creation value.

candidates.title: Desktop Mascot Quick Reference Cheatsheet
candidates.change: Add a new cheatsheet screen before completing onboarding that highlights desktop controls, hotkeys, and hide commands.
candidates.why: Support receives multiple tickets from users confused about how to control, hide, or interact with their pet after setup.

new_controls_cheatsheet.headline: Desktop Pet Controls Cheat Sheet
new_controls_cheatsheet.body: Click and drag to move your pet around. Right-click to hide or summon them anytime.

components.text: Drag & Drop, Double Click Menu, Alt+H Hide Shortcut

candidates.title: Multi-Step Pet Customization Studio
candidates.change: Redesign pick_friend into a split-screen interactive Studio view with live trait selection and mascot preview.
candidates.why: Adoption has a 68.7% conversion rate and a high mean time of 1017s, plus support issues regarding custom pet rendering.

pick_friend.headline: Pet Customization Studio
pick_friend.body: Customize your pet appearance and personality before adoption.

candidates.title: Existing Account Cloud Pet Recovery Notice
candidates.change: Display a prominent hint on the sign-in screen assuring users that logging into an existing account restores saved pets.
candidates.why: Support received 8 emails regarding missing or reset pets after signing in again.

sign_in.hint: Logging into an existing account? Your previously saved pets will automatically restore.

candidates.title: Desktop Renderer Diagnostic Status Timer
candidates.change: Add explicit rendering stage progress and diagnostic helper status to the waiting screen.
candidates.why: The waiting step mean time is 2336s and 3 support emails reported pets failing to render on desktop.

waiting.body: Initializing desktop graphics overlay. Diagnostic check running in background...

candidates.title: Path Selection Express vs Custom Copy
candidates.change: Clarify the distinction between instant preset adoption and photo-based custom pet creation in choose_path copy.
candidates.why: The choose_path mean time is 514s, showing users hesitate while deciding which path to take.

choose_path.headline: Select Creation Method
choose_path.body: Pick an Express Ready-Made Pet in seconds, or Custom Build a pet from your own photos.
choose_path.hint: You can add more pets anytime later from the desktop tray menu.

candidates.title: Adoption Certificate Layout Grid
candidates.change: Reformat the adoption certificate screen into a clear grid layout with prominent verification details.
candidates.why: Adoption drops over 31% of users with an average duration over 16 minutes.

adoption_certificate.headline: Official Desktop Pet Certificate
adoption_certificate.body: Review pet details and confirm your adoption to spawn your mascot.

candidates.title: Desktop Spawn Audio Notification Alert
candidates.change: Add an audio alert notification component when waiting finishes and the desktop pet spawns.
candidates.why: The median time in home/waiting is 201s and mean is 2336s, indicating users minimize or walk away during rendering.

candidates.title: First Day Pet Treat Starter Reward Banner
candidates.change: Display a welcome badge and starter treat incentive banner on the final home_intro screen.
candidates.why: Finish conversion drops to 64.8%, resulting in an overall onboarding completion rate of only 22.1%.
